internal.dataset_exhaustion_caveat: MSD Task08 has exactly 303 series; self-supervised pretraining used all 303 and fine-tuning used the same 303 patient pool. Internal val AND test metrics were computed on data the frozen backbone was exposed to during pretraining — this is dataset exhaustion inherent to a single-organ specialist, not an avoidable split error. Internal numbers are published for transparency only and are NOT evidence of generalization. The external CRLM slice AUROC is the sole release-supporting number.

external_crlm.patient_level_note: patient-level ROC-AUC is undefined on this set (196/197 patients vessel-positive, 1 all-negative); not reported as a metric. Rank correlation is the valid patient-level signal.
external_crlm.label_semantics: Hepatic (seg 3) + Portal (seg 4) vessel present per slice
